snippet.title: Halfbrick+ Cards. Collected by all. Approved by Barry!
snippet.description:
Play Halfbrick+ games! Gain XP and earn exclusive card packs!
Coming first to Jetpack Joyride Racing, Halfbrick+ Cards! You can collect Halfbrick+ Cards after every race - unlock ultra-rare rewards, powerful upgrades, and exclusive seasonal prizes.

Jetpack Joyride Racing is available for pre-registration on iOS & Android!
Pre-register now 🚀 https://halfbrick.link/PreRegJJR
